data.name: Nova Warp
data.detailed_description:
NOVA WARP
is a free-to-play open-sector multiplayer game with three factions. Team up against the creatures of deep space and fight each other for sectors, resources and prestige. Face the dungeon trials with your squad, level up your ship and weapons, build your own ability loadout and throw yourself into massive battles.

⚔️ THREE ALLIANCES, ONE GALAXY

Three alliances fight for control of a connected sector system. Pick your side, defend your home sector, push into enemy territory and win intergalactic events together with your team.

🔴Kharzuun

forge their ships from battle steel. Strike first, ask questions later.

🔵Aelyth

an intelligent species with advanced technology. They strike where you are not looking.

🟣Voruun

organic beings from the dark between the stars. Feared, wrapped in rumours, rarely seen.

🚀 Ship Classes & Abilities

Whether Tank, Support or Damage Dealer: pick your ship class, from the agile Interceptor over the slow and heavily armoured Bulwark, the long-range glass cannon Orion up to the healing support Helix. Level up yourself and your ships, unlock abilities and build the loadout that perfectly complements your squad.

👾 Survive the Dungeons

Team up with other pilots and fight your way through wave-based co-op dungeons packed with unique enemy classes. Destroy the Myxari base, hunt the Megalodon, face the Apex and survive whatever is waiting for you in the Chaos dungeon.

🏆 Live Events: Faction Battles over Rare Resources 

Faction wars, team deathmatch, space football, battle royale and galaxy-wide sector events: regular live events throw all three alliances into one arena and reward the winners.

🤖 In-Game Supporter KAL

The overworked and grumpy sector system info bot answers your questions on the radio, greets you when you log in and sometimes even shows up in person. Just do not expect him to be nice about it.

👑 Rank System

Earn experience points, conquer dungeons and fight other players to climb the ranks and show others who's in charge. Each team can have only one true Warlord. Or shoot your way to the unique special ranks.

💬 YOUR FEEDBACK SHAPES NOVA WARP

NOVA WARP is in active development and it grows in the direction its pilots point. You are warmly invited to tell us what you love, what bothers you and what you want to see next: in the Steam discussions, on our Discord or directly in the game. Every mission report is read, and player feedback constantly flows into new updates, sectors, events and dungeons.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Dual-Core, ~2,0GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Quad-Core, 2,5 GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 / AMD RX 560
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
